record.body:
## Problem

The composer pieces prove themselves only together: an idea is captured, triaged, shown on the roadmap and turned into an effort.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. One end-to-end test drives the real CLI against a temporary store: `orchestra idea`, triage, `orchestra view roadmap`, then the engage path that creates the effort.

## Exit criteria

Decide at plan-phase. The gate: the end-to-end test passes through the installed `orchestra` entry point, and `scripts/test.sh` passes.
